claude_proposed_widenings.name: unbounded_magic_item_activation
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item's form-change procedure is a Bonus Action with no use-count cap or reset cadence, but the current non-spell activation family requires both a resource and a reset cadence.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: While holding this weapon, you can take a Bonus Action to alter its form, turning it into a 6-inch rod ... or a 10-foot pole, or reverting it a Quarterstaff

claude_proposed_widenings.name: equipment_predicate_item_form_state
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Several clauses only apply in quarterstaff form or in quarterstaff-and-pole forms. The current equipment gate can say only that the item is held, worn, armed, or unarmored; it cannot test the held item's current form.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Acrobatic Assist (Quarterstaff and 10-Foot Pole Forms Only) ... Attack Deflection (Quarterstaff Form Only) ... Ranged Weapon (Quarterstaff Form Only)

claude_proposed_widenings.name: triggering_attack_only_ac_bonus
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The reaction grants AC only against the triggering attack. The current `modify_ac` shape is not scoped to a single triggering attack inside a non-spell triggered reaction.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: gaining a +5 bonus to your Armor Class against the triggering attack, potentially causing the attack to miss you

claude_proposed_widenings.name: emit_light
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item can create and extinguish dim light on command. No current effect atom models lighting/illumination.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: you can cause it to emit green Dim Light out to 10 feet ... or you can extinguish the light as a Bonus Action
